Title: System prompt always identifies AI as "Claude by Anthropic" regardless of selected model

Description:

When using Trae IDE (International version, v3.5.57, Windows x64), the system prompt always tells the AI it is "Claude, made by Anthropic" — even when a different model is selected (e.g., DeepSeek, GPT-5.4, or a custom model).

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open Trae IDE
2. Switch the model selector to DeepSeek (or any non-Claude model)
3. Ask the AI: "What model are you?"
4. The AI responds: "I am Claude, made by Anthropic"
Expected behavior: The system prompt identity declaration should dynamically match the selected model, or at minimum be model-agnostic (e.g., "You are Trae AI assistant").

Evidence from logs:

- ai-agent log confirms "model":"deepseek-v4-pro" is the actual model being called
- The system prompt is injected server-side via https://coresg-normal.trae.ai/api/agent/v3/create_agent_task and is not editable locally
Impact: This causes user confusion about which model is actually running, and undermines trust in the model switching feature.

Environment:

- Trae IDE v3.5.57 (International)
- Windows 10/11 x64
- Affects all non-Claude models including custom models
